## Entry checklist

Skip this part if the PR does not add or change an entry. Details: [Suggesting a List Entry](https://github.com/Sri-Krishna-V/awesome-adk-agents/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#suggesting-a-list-entry).

- [ ] The line follows `- <level> [<label>](<url>) <🏭> - <Description.>` in the matching section.
- [ ] The URL appears nowhere else in the README.
- [ ] Rule 1: it uses Google ADK (or, for an article or tutorial, teaches it).
- [ ] Rule 2: updated within the last 6 months, not archived.
- [ ] Rule 3: its README has setup steps.
- [ ] Rule 4: it adds something no existing entry covers.
- [ ] `npx awesome-lint README.md` reports no errors.
